meta_description:
24K likes, 359 comments - bazaarindia on October 9, 2026: "Finding your footing doesn’t always mean having it all figured out. For Harper’s Bazaar India’s October digital cover star, Shanaya Kapoor (@shanayakapoor02), it means staying curious, embracing her vulnerable side, and showing up with honesty. The actor opens up about finding her rhythm on set, trusting her instincts, and learning to step outside her comfort zone. “When I’m reading a script, it should make me feel scared about how I am going to do this. I like to treat it as a challenge.”

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

Editor: Rasna Bhasin (@rasnabhasin)
Interview: Jhanvi Duggal (@jhanvii.23)
Photographer: Tuhin Chandra (@tuhin_chandra)
Stylist: Dolla Baruah (@dollaypop)
Cover Design: Mandeep Singh Khokhar (@mandy_khokhar19)
Make-up Artist: Riddhima Sharma (@makeupbyriddhima)
Hair Artist: Hiral Bhatia (@hiralbhatia)
Editorial Coordinator: Shalini Kanojia (@shalinikanojia)
Assistant Stylist: Tanya Doshi (@_tanyaa14_) and Shrushti Nisar (@shrushti.nisar.9)
Assistant Coordinator: Shruti Gupta (@howdoyousayshruti)
Artist PR Agency: Think Talkies (@think_talkies)

Shanaya is wearing Hotfix bodysuit, H&M X Elie Saab (@hm) (@eliesaabworld)

#HarpersBazaarIndia #DigitalCover #ShanayaKapoor".
